title: Enemies and what they do
summary: R.E.P.O. throws several different monsters at your crew, and each one behaves differently: some chase you, some grab you, some throw things or simply will not stop walking.
body: Each monster is its own thing in the game, so you can expect a different threat from each one rather than a single reskinned enemy.
The game keeps track of what a monster is currently doing, which is why a monster can switch between calmly walking and attacking you.
The names this site verified are: a small round chaser, a grabber that latches onto you, a slow walker, a thrower and a hugger.
What this entry does not tell you: how much damage each monster does, how much health it has, or how fast it moves. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The game defines several distinct monsters rather than one enemy type.
One monster is built around throwing something at you.
A monster can latch onto and hold a player.
